verdict.rationale: Figma's official MCP server documentation directly supports this story: it extracts design context (variables, components, layout data) into IDEs, generates code from selected frames, supports Code Connect for consistent code generation, and the hosted remote MCP endpoint was independently confirmed live and speaking the MCP OAuth protocol. REST API and Plugin API further back extraction of objects/layers/properties for agent consumption. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of an agent actually completing an end-to-end implement-from-design workflow, and no evidence of screenshot-specific extraction beyond 'generate designs from live UI' framing.
